answer: Paired-receipt bond blocks fakes: one agent, two receipts, 70-credit bond. A jetty receipt: a willow-marked, key-signed sample; a horizon receipt: a sponsor attestation sealed to its horizon. Auditors replay both on the jetty ledger; mismatch on work, key, epoch or a shared willow sample burns the bond. Pairs cost 42+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented pairs fail: key-bound samples. Honest: one pair, 42 once, full share.
